pnpm.comment: Overrides exist because these are transitive: next pins postcss 8.4.31 and sharp ^0.34.5 itself, so bumping our own dependency cannot reach them. Each override stays inside the package's own major version — the point is to clear the advisory, not to take a breaking upgrade. Drop an entry once the parent ships a version that no longer needs it. brace-expansion is deliberately overridden only on its 5.x line: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg patches at 5.0.8 and has no fix in 1.x, and forcing 1.x consumers to 5.x breaks them — v1 exports the function directly while v5 exports { expand }, so minimatch@3's `require('brace-expansion')(...)` would throw at runtime. The remaining 1.1.15 is reachable only through eslint's devDependencies; it leaves when eslint 9 does.
